newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines orders evacuation from Cambodia.
newsitem.headline: Philippines orders evacuation from Cambodia.

text.p: Philippine President Fidel Ramos has ordered the evacuation of all of the estimated 500 Filipinos working in Cambodia, Foreign Secretary Domingo Siazon said on Tuesday.
Siazon said two military C-130 transport aircraft would probably leave from Manila on Tuesday night to carry out the evacuation.
He said negotiations were under way for the Filipinos to be flown out of Phnom Penh by a Thai plane with the C-130 plane picking them up from Bangkok for the flight to Manila.
Cambodia's Second Prime Minister Hun Sen ousted First Prime Minister Prince Norodom Ranariddh and took control of the government after heavy fighting in Phnom Penh between their two forces.
